claim: Alphabet disclosed $96.4B in revenue and $30.5B in net income for fiscal Q2 2025.
summary: Revenue of ~$96.4B for Alphabet Q2 2025 is correct, but net income of $30.5B is incorrect; actual Q2 2025 net income was ~$28.2B. Claim is contradicted.

sub_claims.text: Alphabet disclosed $96.4B in revenue for fiscal Q2 2025
sub_claims.note: From own knowledge through cutoff: Alphabet Q2 2025 revenue was about $96.43B, consistent with $96.4B rounded.

sub_claims.text: Alphabet disclosed $30.5B in net income for fiscal Q2 2025
sub_claims.note: From own knowledge through cutoff: Alphabet Q2 2025 net income was about $28.2B, not $30.5B. The $30.5B figure overstates net income by over $2B.
